calls.prompt: Full-body orthographic front view of a cinder hound, a lean long-bodied hunting hound made of cracked dark cinder and ash: a long low body with a deep narrow chest and a tucked belly, a narrow pointed skull on a long neck, a long closed muzzle, short upright pointed ears, long thin legs with compact paws, and a long thin tail. Broad glowing ember-orange bands run across the cinder like wide cracks: a collar band round the neck, a band over each shoulder and each hip, a band round each ankle, and the eyes glow ember orange. It stands in a neutral four-legged stance: the back level, all four legs straight and slightly apart, clear of each other and of the body, paws flat, the head raised on the neck and looking straight ahead, the mouth closed, the tail held straight out behind. No fire, no flames, no smoke, no sparks, no effects. It faces the camera directly, symmetrical, the whole creature from the top of the head to the feet visible with empty margin around it, centred on a plain flat light grey background, no scenery, no ground, a single creature. Game-ready 3D creature model reference for a modeller: simple large readable shapes, chunky forms, matte surfaces, one flat colour per material with no pattern and no texture detail. Palette blocks: cinder body dark charcoal grey, glowing bands and eyes bright ember orange, paws and claws black. Soft even studio light, no cast shadows, no text, no labels, no grid, no watermark.
